metadata.source_scope: Allowed sources from Blocker Burndown 01 prompt

question_answers.minimum_safe_clsh_change: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED: first establish deterministic register-address mapping strategy (reuse existing WCD937X mode vs new WCD9378 variant) with runtime proof, then patch only the class-h layer required by that proof.
must_remain_fail_closed: Whether WCD9378 can reuse WCD937X class-h version semantics unchanged.
Whether `wcd-clsh-v2` needs a new codec enum for WCD9378.
Whether dynamic analog base belongs in common class-h code or per-driver indirection.

evidence.supports: Upstream WCD937x allocates Class-H control with enum value `WCD937X`.
No `WCD9378` enum exists in current class-h version list.
Allocator stores only `codec_version`; no additional base/address context is provided.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Collect runtime evidence to determine if WCD9378 behaves identically to `WCD937X` class-h flow; if not, add explicit WCD9378 handling in class-h v2.

evidence.supports: Defines calculate WCD9378 analog domain at 0x40180000.
Datasheet is feature-level only and does not contradict WCD9378 derivative context, but provides no register-map proof.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Preserve 0x40180000-domain evidence in conversion planning and verify translated runtime addresses in upstream regmap path.

evidence.supports: Class-H v2 currently hardcodes base-address-derived registers at 0x3000 domain.
Downstream legacy class-h header also hardcodes 0x3000 base.
Downstream WCD9378 register model uses 0x40180000 analog base, indicating address-domain mismatch risk.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Validate effective runtime register addresses for class-h operations before deciding whether base abstraction update is required.

evidence.supports: WCD9378 exposes Class-G/VNEGDAC and relevant PA/BIAS register names in its analog domain.
Downstream codec has dedicated Class-H DAPM supply handling and class-h initialization path.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Map required WCD9378 class-h register interactions onto upstream class-h v2 API once address semantics are proven.

blocker_decisions.blocker: Friend-note claim: add dynamic `ana_base` to class-h

evidence.supports: Control object stores only codec version; no dynamic base field exists.
Public enum/API has no base-address argument.
Register operations use fixed macros, not runtime-programmed base values.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Do not introduce dynamic-base changes without concrete failing register trace proving fixed-base path is incorrect for WCD9378 upstream integration.

blocker_decisions.blocker: Placement of Class-H changes (WCD common vs WCD9378 driver-only)

evidence.supports: Main driver calls shared class-h allocation API.
Class-H state machine behavior is centralized in shared module.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Keep scope open but blocked until runtime evidence shows whether adaptation belongs entirely in shared class-h module or can be isolated in codec driver configuration.
